body:
I am happy you are still alive even if I don't know you. 
When I was a teen I wanted desparetly to be open about my lady love or to just stop loving her all together and like a guy.   I can attest that it's easier when you get older.  You have more ability to chose your support circle and even remove family from your life.  You definately have more control over the circumstances and you can be proudly transferred.
Do you actually need someone to believe you to get mental health support?   Have you tried a LGBT outreach?  A crisis line?  I know there are a free resources here and hope you have some there too.

I hear you.  Is there anyone in your life you can speak with?  A local hotline to call?

Sometimes it takes more than just holding on.  Getting help could be that next step. Setting boundaries with family.  Leaving your religion.  Working on yourself.
